판정

No confirmed malicious supply-chain compromise indicators — overall risk: info.

악성 공급망 징후

No confirmed malicious supply-chain indicators.

자동 실행 경로

  • Based on the provided extracted/selected files and pre-scan results, there is no evidence of .pth, sitecustomize.py, usercustomize.py, setup.py install-time execution, suspicious PEP 517 build hooks, or execution on Python interpreter startup.
  • window.AdminCharts.renderAll(document) in charts.js appears to be normal browser-side chart rendering for the admin UI, not a Python package install-time or interpreter-startup supply-chain execution path.
  • Any ordinary CLI/entry point that requires explicit user invocation was not treated as malicious automatic execution.

절취/전송/지속성/측면이동/은닉

  • Credential theft: no evidence of broad discovery of environment variables, .env files, SSH keys, cloud credentials, GitHub/PyPI/npm tokens, or CI/CD secrets.
  • Exfiltration/staging: no evidence of archive staging, temporary collection of harvested files, base64-based staging, webhook/C2/raw-IP upload, or external exfiltration.
  • Persistence: no evidence of cron, systemd, launch agents, shell profile modification, background polling loops, or self-reinstall logic.
  • Lateral movement: no evidence of Kubernetes service-account token use, Docker socket access, cloud metadata access, GitHub Actions token theft, or workflow injection.
  • Obfuscation/loader: the pre-scan obfuscation/encryption hits appear to be false positives from normal minified JavaScript, regex usage, CSP nonces, and Bootstrap Icons CSS/fonts. No malicious loader or encrypted payload was confirmed.

배포 무결성 이상

  • Bootstrap Icons font files (.woff, .woff2) and minified vendor JavaScript/CSS are explainable as admin UI static assets; no unexplained native binary or hidden payload was confirmed.
  • The presence of .gitignore in the sdist is not, by itself, evidence of a malicious supply-chain compromise.
  • From the provided material, there is no confirmed sudden dependency insertion, typosquatting, wheel/sdist mismatch, or executable payload present only in the PyPI artifact.

추가 확인 필요

  • The input is limited to 30 selected files out of 108 total files plus partial text corpus; full static review of all files is still recommended.
  • Large/minified vendor files and font binaries should be compared against upstream originals or verified by hash where possible.
  • Additional checks should compare the distribution artifact against the public source repository, review the complete pyproject.toml build backend/entry-point configuration, and compare any wheel artifact against the sdist if a wheel exists.
